WITH 'R5-243532' AS target
OPTIONAL MATCH (request)
WHERE (request:Tdoc OR request:CR) AND request.tdocNumber = target
OPTIONAL MATCH (request)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK|HAS_CR]-(pack:CRPack)
WITH target, collect(DISTINCT pack) AS packs
OPTIONAL MATCH (resolution:Resolution)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION|DISPOSITION_OF]-(disposition:DecisionDisposition),
               (resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(meeting:Meeting)
WHERE (disposition.targetTdocNumber = target
       OR (disposition)-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(:Tdoc {tdocNumber: target}))
  AND replace(replace(replace(toLower(coalesce(meeting.workingGroup, '')), ' ', ''), '_', ''), '-', '')
      IN ['ran5', 'ranwg5', 'tsgran5', 'tsgranwg5', 'r5']
  AND replace(replace(replace(toLower(coalesce(resolution.resolutionScope, '')), ' ', ''), '_', ''), '-', '')
      IN ['document', 'wholedocument', 'tdoc', 'wholetdoc', 'documentlevel', 'tdoclevel', 'whole']
  AND replace(replace(replace(toLower(coalesce(disposition.dispositionCode, '')), ' ', ''), '_', ''), '-', '')
      IN ['withdrawn', 'nottreated', 'notpursued', 'rejected', 'notagreed']
WITH packs, count(DISTINCT disposition) AS closing_decisions
WHERE size(packs) > 0 OR closing_decisions = 0
UNWIND CASE WHEN size(packs) > 0 THEN packs ELSE [null] END AS pack
RETURN DISTINCT
  CASE WHEN pack IS NULL THEN 'INSUFFICIENT_RECORDS' ELSE pack.crPackId END AS cr_pack,
  CASE WHEN pack IS NULL THEN 'INSUFFICIENT_RECORDS' ELSE pack.tsgMeeting END AS tsg_meeting
